statement: The written iteration-six proof gives full-split-Dickson membership equivalence for all-Fp affine S3 trees on an odd-order rational elliptic curve with a nonzero oriented target; an exact quadratic augmentation has mk+3m-5 variables and mk+3m-4 equations for m>=2,k>=1. A freely ordered comb is complete for nonzero-total signed multisets of m<=n points in a prime-order group; arbitrary balanced topologies are not. Explicit closure guards, a twist-ghost example and complete cost terms are provided. No solving-degree bound or speedup is established.
